hypothesis: The one-field planner is viable, but symbolic actions must not compete with material execution. Gating grow, secure, and finish to material action families will eliminate the hosted alliance loop without expanding the planner contract.

single_variable.changed: Before utility ranking, retain only actions that directly change territory, force, infrastructure, or immediate survival. If none exists, prefer hold over symbolic activity.

local_acceptance: focused intent and integration suites pass
grow selects material progress instead of alliance when both are legal
secure selects immediate material defense instead of alliance when both are legal
symbolic-only menu selects hold when hold is legal
exact-image bounded 16-player trace has no rejection, fallback, or degradation
hosted_kill_bar: any unexplained fallback, degradation, rejection, or parse failure
